titleEn: The bus is starting up, so let’s hurry

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Tā ràng wǒ xiàng nín wènhǎo.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.
words.when: Remember 送 like delivering / seeing off — 送来 / 送送你.
words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean give/deliver/see off.

example.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng gěi nín sòng qù.

words.en: to go over; to pass by

words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean go over (direction).

words.en: to come over; to come by

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wǒ àiren hái zài lóuxià děng wǒ ne.

example.pinyin: Wǒmen yào chūqù bàn diǎnr shìr.

words.usage: Most Chinese speakers mean right away.

example.pinyin: Mǎshàng yào kāichē le.
example.en: The bus is about to leave.

words.note: Headword pinyin printed in the book. Example-sentence pinyin not printed; standard pinyin added.

dialogues.label: 课文（一）
dialogues.headingZh: 我给您捎来了一些东西
dialogues.headingEn: I've brought some things for you

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 王老师吗？我是小林。
lines.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī ma? Wǒ shì Xiǎo Lín.
lines.en: Teacher Wang? This is Xiao Lin.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 啊，小林。你不是到台湾开汉语教学研讨会去了吗？
lines.pinyin: A, Xiǎo Lín. Nǐ bú shì dào Táiwān kāi Hànyǔ jiàoxué yántǎohuì qù le ma?
lines.en: Ah, Xiao Lin. Didn’t you go to Taiwan for a Chinese-teaching seminar?

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 我开完会回来了。昨天晚上刚到家。我回来的时候，经过香港，到小赵家去看了看。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ kāi wán huì huílai le. Zuótiān wǎnshang gāng dào jiā. Wǒ huílai de shíhou, jīngguò Xiānggǎng, dào Xiǎo Zhào jiā qù kàn le kan.
lines.en: I’m back from the meeting — just got home last night. On the way I passed through Hong Kong and visited Xiao Zhao.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 是吗？小赵好吗？
lines.pinyin: Shì ma? Xiǎo Zhào hǎo ma?
lines.en: Really? How’s Xiao Zhao?

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 挺好的。她让我向您问好，还让我给您捎来一些东西。我想给您送去。
lines.pinyin: Tǐng hǎo de. Tā ràng wǒ xiàng nín wènhǎo, hái ràng wǒ gěi nín shāo lái yìxiē dōngxi. Wǒ xiǎng gěi nín sòng qù.
lines.en: She’s fine. She sends regards and asked me to bring you some things. I’d like to deliver them.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 谢谢，我过去取吧。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie, wǒ guòqù qǔ ba.
lines.en: Thanks — I’ll come get them.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 不用。我正好要下楼去，顺便就给您带去了。
lines.pinyin: Bú yòng. Wǒ zhènghǎo yào xià lóu qù, shùnbiàn jiù gěi nín dài qù le.
lines.en: No need. I’m heading downstairs anyway — I’ll bring them by.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 那好，你过来吧。
lines.pinyin: Nà hǎo, nǐ guòlái ba.
lines.en: Alright, come over.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 王老师，这是小赵带给您的东西。
lines.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī, zhè shì Xiǎo Zhào dài gěi nín de dōngxi.
lines.en: Teacher Wang, these are from Xiao Zhao.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 辛苦你了，小林！还麻烦你跑一趟。外边冷，快进屋来坐吧。
lines.pinyin: Xīnkǔ nǐ le, Xiǎo Lín! Hái máfan nǐ pǎo yí tàng. Wàibian lěng, kuài jìn wū lái zuò ba.
lines.en: Thanks for the trouble! Come in — it’s cold outside.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 不进去了。我爱人还在楼下等我呢，我们要出去办点儿事儿。
lines.pinyin: Bú jìnqù le. Wǒ àiren hái zài lóuxià děng wǒ ne, wǒmen yào chūqù bàn diǎnr shìr.
lines.en: I won’t go in. My spouse is waiting downstairs — we’re running an errand.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 我送送你。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ sòngsong nǐ.
lines.en: I’ll see you out.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 不用送了，请回吧。
lines.pinyin: Bú yòng sòng le, qǐng huí ba.
lines.en: No need — please go back.

lines.speaker: 王老师
lines.zh: 慢走！
lines.pinyin: Màn zǒu!
lines.en: Take care!

dialogues.label: 课文（二）
dialogues.headingEn: The bus is starting up, so let's hurry

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 下边的同学快上来吧，马上要开车了。
lines.pinyin: Xiàbian de tóngxué kuài shànglái ba, mǎshàng yào kāichē le.
lines.en: Students below, hurry up — we’re about to leave.

lines.speaker: 麦克
lines.zh: 老师，我不上去了，我到后边的五号车去可以吗？我朋友在那儿。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, wǒ bú shàngqù le, wǒ dào hòubian de wǔ hào chē qù kěyǐ ma? Wǒ péngyou zài nàr.
lines.en: Teacher, may I go to bus No. 5 behind? My friend’s there.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 你过去吧。玛丽怎么还没上来呢？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ guòqù ba. Mǎlì zěnme hái méi shànglái ne?
lines.en: Go ahead. Why hasn’t Mary gotten on yet?

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 她忘带照相机了，又回宿舍去拿了，一会儿就回来。啊，她跑来了。玛丽，快点儿，就要开车了。
lines.pinyin: Tā wàng dài zhàoxiàngjī le, yòu huí sùshè qù ná le, yíhuìr jiù huílai. A, tā pǎo lái le. Mǎlì, kuài diǎnr, jiù yào kāichē le.
lines.en: She forgot her camera and went back to the dorm — she’ll be right back. Oh, here she comes. Mary, hurry!

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 对不起，我来晚了。
lines.pinyin: Duìbuqǐ, wǒ lái wǎn le.
lines.en: Sorry I’m late.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 没关系。
lines.pinyin: Méiguānxi.
lines.en: It’s fine.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 玛丽，这儿还有座位，你过来吧。
lines.pinyin: Mǎlì, zhèr hái yǒu zuòwèi, nǐ guòlái ba.
lines.en: Mary, there’s a seat here — come over.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 请大家注意，我再说一下儿。我们今天去参观出土文物展览。这个展览大约要参观两个半小时。参观完以后，四点钟坐车回来。要求大家四点准时上车。不回来的同学跟我说一声。听清楚了没有？
lines.pinyin: Qǐng dàjiā zhùyì, wǒ zài shuō yíxiàr. Wǒmen jīntiān qù cānguān chūtǔ wénwù zhǎnlǎn. Zhège zhǎnlǎn dàyuē yào cānguān liǎng ge bàn xiǎoshí. Cānguān wán yǐhòu, sì diǎn zhōng zuò chē huílai. Yāoqiú dàjiā sì diǎn zhǔnshí shàng chē. Bù huílai de tóngxué gēn wǒ shuō yì shēng. Tīng qīngchu le méiyǒu?
lines.en: Attention — we’re visiting an unearthed relics exhibition, about 2.5 hours. Return by bus at 4; be on time. Anyone not coming back, tell me. Clear?

lines.speaker: 留学生
lines.zh: 听清楚了。
lines.pinyin: Tīng qīngchu le.
lines.en: Clear.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 大家要记住开车的时间。都上来了吗？好，师傅，开车吧。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā yào jìzhù kāichē de shíjiān. Dōu shànglái le ma? Hǎo, shīfu, kāichē ba.
lines.en: Remember departure time. Everyone on? Driver, let’s go.

lines.speaker: 山本
lines.zh: 老师，您到这儿来坐吧。
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, nín dào zhèr lái zuò ba.
lines.en: Teacher, please sit here.

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 我不过去了，就坐这儿了，你快坐下吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bú guòqù le, jiù zuò zhèr le, nǐ kuài zuòxia ba.
lines.en: I’ll stay here — you sit down.

lines.speaker: 玛丽
lines.zh: 老师，参观完以后，我想到大使馆去看朋友，不回学校去了，可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Lǎoshī, cānguān wán yǐhòu, wǒ xiǎng dào dàshǐguǎn qù kàn péngyou, bù huí xuéxiào qù le, kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: After the visit, may I go to the embassy to see a friend instead of returning to school?

lines.speaker: 林老师
lines.zh: 可以。
lines.pinyin: Kěyǐ.
lines.en: Sure.

notes.title: 小林
notes.body: 中国人比较熟悉的人之间常用“小＋姓”称呼年轻人；用“老＋姓”称呼年纪大的人。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Wáng lǎoshī ma? Wǒ shì Xiǎo Lín.
example.en: Teacher Wang? This is Xiao Lin.

notes.title: 还麻烦你跑一趟
notes.body: “趟”是动量词，表示走动的次数。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Hái máfan nǐ pǎo yí tàng.
example.en: And I troubled you to make a trip.

notes.title: 慢走！
notes.body: 送客人时说的客套话。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.pinyin: Màn zǒu!
example.en: Take care!

notes.title: 跟我说一声
notes.body: 这里的“声”是量词，表示声音发出的次数。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 不回来的同学跟我说一声。
example.pinyin: Bù huílai de tóngxué gēn wǒ shuō yì shēng.
example.en: Anyone not coming back, tell me.

notes.title: 简单趋向补语：动词＋来/去
notes.body: 动词“来”和“去”用在一些动词后作补语表示动作趋向。向着说话人用“来”；背着说话人用“去”。宾语是处所词时，放在动词之后、“来/去”之前。 Example-sentence pinyin not printed in the book; standard pinyin added.

example.zh: 快上来吧，马上要开车了。
example.pinyin: Kuài shànglái ba, mǎshàng yào kāichē le.
example.en: Hurry up onto the bus — we’re about to leave.
